subject.title: fix(wechat): preserve existing accounts across hot reload

question: Must this WeChat hot-reload fix demonstrate a redacted live A+B QR-login handoff before merge, or is the focused gateway lifecycle regression suite sufficient for this provider-backed path?
rationale: The contributor has repeatedly and candidly documented that no approved live WeChat environment is available; choosing whether provider proof is mandatory is a gateway-owner acceptance threshold, not a mechanical code repair.

options.title: Require live WeChat proof
options.body: Keep the PR blocked until someone with an approved WeChat setup records or logs a redacted account-A/account-B reload showing account A remains usable.

options.title: Accept lifecycle proof
options.body: Explicitly waive provider-session proof and merge only after the current head’s required checks complete successfully.

recommendation.title: Require live WeChat proof
recommendation.body: Keep the PR blocked until someone with an approved WeChat setup records or logs a redacted account-A/account-B reload showing account A remains usable.

likelyOwner.reason: The timeline routed the original gateway review to this person, and the unresolved choice is specifically about gateway proof sufficiency.
